records.actualImplementation: The workflow action visual preview is an enabled MUI Button with pointerEvents:none and no action, disabled, aria-hidden or tabIndex override. MUI ButtonBase defaults to component=button, disabled=false and tabIndex=0; pointer-events does not remove keyboard/assistive semantics.
records.impact: A purely decorative preview can become a focusable no-op button/duplicate control. This is a source-confirmed semantics issue; no browser focus-order or screen-reader behavior was executed. It is not evidence that runtime approval or field placement commands are missing.
records.recommendation: Render decorative preview with a non-button primitive or an explicitly inert preview variant; keep the actual editable/action controls unchanged. Validate keyboard focus and drag preview before closure.

records.actualImplementation: Global scrollbar styling only defines ::-webkit-scrollbar/track/thumb/hover. Source search found no scrollbar-color or scrollbar-width declaration in application source.
records.impact: The app-owned custom scrollbar appearance has no standards fallback and falls back to browser defaults on engines ignoring WebKit pseudo-elements. This is a source-confirmed cross-engine style gap, not evidence that scrolling is broken or data is inaccessible.
records.recommendation: When addressing global scrollbar consistency, add standards properties using the same maintained tokens and preserve forced-colors/system behavior; verify Firefox and WebKit separately.
